card.name: Inside clinical term words like creatinine
card.fires_on: The last piece of a medical term already begun, mostly the ending of creatinine. It also fires on the closing words of terms such as heart failure, ketoacidosis, lactic acidosis and suicidal ideation, in warnings and lab-monitoring text.
